name: azure-databricks-geniespace
title: Azure Databricks Genie Space
summary: Query a curated Azure Databricks Genie space using natural language and Unity Catalog-governed data.
description: Connect Foundry agents to one Azure Databricks Genie space at its workspace MCP endpoint. The space translates natural-language questions into SQL over its curated data, with access governed by Unity Catalog permissions. A workspace administrator must enable Managed MCP Servers, and the Genie space must be shared with the connecting identity. This endpoint is read-only and does not carry conversation history.
